newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji shares slip on loss-cut selling.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji shares slip on loss-cut selling.

text.p: Shares in Japanese consumer financing firm Takefuji Corp slipped in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Tuesday, hurt by loss-cut sales by investors, traders said.
They said the share price fell to its lowest since the issue went public on August 30.
The share price lost 260 yen to close at 8,960 yen, after briefly dropping to 8,900 yen. Volume was 119,200 shares.

The issue invited loss-cut selling because the outlook for the consumer financing sector was bleak, and incentive-backed shares have been active and attracted investors' attention recently amid a lack of trading factors, one analyst at a second-tier Japanese securities house said.
